Flow design uses a packed bed of Pd(OH)2/Al2O3 to enhance gas-liquid-solid contact. Acetic acid is included to enhance rate. Temperature is 60°C. Pressure is set to 20 bar (max available BPR) to increase H2 solubility and drive reaction, exceeding the minimum 3 bar calculated. Residence time is set to 6 min based on calculation, which is a significant reduction from 5h batch (50x IF). Axial dispersion (Pe=69) is noted but acceptable for initial screen.
